Heavy Rain has multiple areas where a main character can die, thus influencing the rest of the story from that point. It's far more important/impactful on your first playthough, though... If there was a harder difficulty, like one that's actually demanding gameplay-wise, I think it would rank as a masterpiece. The chances you have throughout the game to unknowingly determine whether a specific character lives or dies pile up and influence the relative attractiveness of each decision.
